bullets.title: Near weekly low
bullets.text: Gold traded near 3,540 this morning in Asia, close to Monday's 3,539.80 low; the exact quote time is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Rebound erased
bullets.text: A tech-stock selloff and a firm dollar pushed gold back under 3,593 and 3,550 after Tuesday's 2.2% drop.

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: Markets price about a 95% chance of a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December, which keeps pressure on gold.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 103.8 and the US 10-year yield is near 4.90%, both still high for gold (UNVERIFIED, one source).

bullets.title: Oversold short term

bullets.title: PCE today
bullets.text: PCE, GDP and durable goods at 15:30 SAST are today's big test, and Thanksgiving on Thursday will thin trading.
